classroom.caption: Kingside Classroom, tutor view mid-lesson: a live Italian Game attack synced to every student, full notation, captured-material count, a 3x3 control panel, kid-friendly chat, and live video tiles for the tutor and three students.
The same moment from a student's seat: the tutor's position and notation arrive in real time over WebSockets, with the tutor on video and class chat alongside.
Live guess-the-move quiz: the tutor freezes the position, students answer on their own boards, and results grade themselves (two correct, one miss) before the tutor reveals.
Breakout games with chess clocks: the tutor runs two student-vs-student games at once, with live mini-boards, running 5+3 clocks and move counts, while the main lesson board stays put.
Positive reinforcement built in: the tutor awards a Checkmate Crown sticker and a crown-and-name celebration animates across the classroom view.
Kingside Classroom on a phone: the synced board, a picture-in-picture tutor video, and a bottom nav for video, chat, moves and more.
Parent dashboard: curriculum progress, time spent, stickers earned, tutor-written lesson summaries and upcoming lessons for one child.
Tutor lesson prep: today's classes with rosters, the week ahead, and per-student curriculum progress so the tutor knows where each kid is before class starts.

Live classroom (tutor view): synced board with a loaded position, notation, a control panel for FEN/PGN, homework, courses and players, live chat, puzzle mode, quizzes, games and sticker rewards, with video tiles for up to four students.

family.caption: Parent view of a child chess-band journey: colour-coded band chapters from trial to Navy with lesson progress.
Parent billing portal: balance, prepaid credit, term prepayments, payment method and invoices in one page.

franchise.caption: Launch Progress tracker: one row per owner with step progress, last completed step, highest step reached, last-active recency and skipped-step flags for the Kingside Launch onboarding program.
Franchise Help Desk: ticketing with triage, ownership, waiting-on-market states, urgency, due dates and per-assignee queues.
Competitive Intel: dot-plot benchmarking of the brand franchise fee, total investment and royalty against other franchisors disclosure documents, with figure-verification coverage.

hiring.caption: Kingside Hiring candidate record: stage accordion, scorecards, offer and activity tabs plus a contact and details side panel, all on the fictional Chesslandia market.
Offer tab with a five-step hire checklist (offer, agreement, signature, background check, tutor account) showing a fully onboarded candidate.
Staff-only practice job board where a fictional posting can be applied to and followed through interviews, offer and onboarding with no real email sent.
Searchable settings home ("What do you want to change?") with quick-search chips and grouped personal and organization settings.
Job setup wizard (four phases with progress ring) on the Interview Kits step: phone-screen and video-audition kits with prep items and scorecard attributes.
Searchable, filterable candidates table for a job with avatars, stages and export, 45 fictional candidates.
Hiring dashboard for the fictional Chesslandia market: KPI tiles (jobs, applications, scorecards, time to hire, conversion) and an Attention Required queue of stuck candidates by stage.

hq.caption: AI Governance: model-gateway spend, tokens, requests and models used, with spend-over-time, spend-by-model and a per-key / per-agent usage table.
Product Usage: per-app active users by role, page views, guide reads and helpfulness, top routes and guide-article performance, read from each app's own usage table.
EOS Scorecard: nine weekly measurables with named owners, thirteen weeks of trailing data and green/red target coloring for a one-glance weekly pulse.

opshub.caption: Client Conversion tracker for Kingside Learning: won clients with stage, lead source, tutor pairing and conversion reason in one filterable table.
Booking Hub: evergreen public booking forms with QR codes, printable flyers, labels per market and active/trial filters, all managed from one screen.
Client 360 view: profile, activity, communications, tutor reviews, accounting, billing and cancellations tabs, with every job the family has running and its status.
Tutor profile with Schedule tab: upcoming lessons, lessons needing completion, reports owed and cancellation rate, plus tabs for quality, comms, accounting and development.
Lessons ledger: every upcoming, completed, cancelled and needs-completion lesson in one searchable, filterable, exportable table with client, students, tutor and job.
Job Builder wizard: pick a pre-configured template (clubs, camps, pickups) then fill details and confirm, so new programs launch in three guided steps.
Accounting: raised invoices filterable by paid, unpaid, pending and void with a live totals panel (count, gross, net, tax, still to pay) and CSV exports.
Growth hub for franchise markets: brand kit, graphics, photography, Canva templates and merch ordering, with a guided three-step launch checklist for a new market.
In-app Guide: searchable how-to library organised by area (scheduling, CCT, accounting, billing, payments) with article counts, so non-technical staff self-serve.
Forecast Accuracy panel: every completed week compares predicted vs actual bank deposits with per-week accuracy and bias badges, plus weekday-fit, bias and weekly error summary chips.
Cash forecast Eval harness: an independent weekly grader scores forecast accuracy, bias and a rule-of-thumb baseline, and replays challenger tunings so the model improves week over week.
Ask the Analyst: plain-English question answered with a live chart of weekly client invoice collections, with chat history, query inspection and suggested follow-ups.

cash-forecast-eval.caption: Forecast Accuracy panel: every completed week compares predicted vs actual bank deposits with per-week accuracy and bias badges, plus weekday-fit, bias and weekly error summary chips.
Cash forecast Eval harness: an independent weekly grader scores forecast accuracy, bias and a rule-of-thumb baseline, and replays challenger tunings so the model improves week over week.

school.caption: School admin dashboard: class, student and lesson counts, next-term agreement status, recent lessons and invoices at a glance.
Class cards per school program showing instructors, enrolled students, lessons delivered and next session.
Sortable searchable student roster with attendance counts, last attended and one-click roster confirmation and export.
Principal-ready program impact report with lessons delivered, students, terms run and a rebooking call to action.

sign.caption: Documents admin table for the Chesslandia team: status chips, visibility, signers and filters/export across 14 documents.
Document audit trail event timeline: created, signer emails sent, sent, each with timestamp and hash disclosure for a tamper-evident chain.
Template field editor over a PDF with auto-fill merge fields (candidate, market, job title) placed on the page, plus fields/signers/properties dock.
Guided send flow: step 1 of 2, add signers and agreement details that are merged into the PDF before a signing link is issued (not sent).
Template library with status, visibility scope (team/organization), field counts, usage counts and one-click Send/Edit.

studio.caption: Curriculum assistant answering a teaching question with structured sections and clickable module/lesson citations, plus conversation history and Story Mode.
Curriculum browser: 93 lessons grouped by module with per-lesson illustration counts, search and concept filter.
Curriculum generator with saved templates (tactical training, opening explorer, knight adventure), age bands and single/batch modes (nothing generated).
Admin canon-gap scanner: flags invented names across 93 lessons against 51 characters and 20 landmarks, with one-click create or dismiss.
AI pipeline health admin: 1,506 embedded curriculum chunks, 950 illustrations, 51 characters and canon readiness, shown as status-dotted metric tiles.

tutors.caption: Kingside Tutors admin roster for a market: status tabs, filters, bulk email and CSV export over a searchable tutor table.
Onboarding cohort training tracker with ATS link, cert debrief scheduling, reminder cadence and per-tutor readiness grid.
In-app tutor guide with illustrated hero and instant search across lessons, printables and tutor profiles.

ai-voice-interviewer.caption: Candidate side: the AI recruiter Ada runs a friendly text screen right on the applicant's status page, with typed or recorded voice answers
Candidate side: after the chat, the status page invites the applicant to a 10-minute in-browser voice interview with Ada, no phone or scheduling needed
Candidate side on a phone: the Ada screening chat is built mobile-first, since most hourly applicants apply from their phones
Candidate side on a phone: the voice interview card with prep tips, Start Now, and an option to schedule the call for later
Recruiter side: Ada's voice screen scorecard with an overall score, an Advance recommendation, and six weighted dimensions from creativity to chess familiarity
Recruiter side: AI-written strengths and concerns sit above the full voice call transcript, so a recruiter can check every claim against what the candidate said
Recruiter side: a human makes the call. Recruiters record Advance, Review, or Reject and rate Ada's accuracy, which feeds the calibration audit
Recruiter side: every AI screening in one queue with scores, recommendations, knockouts, and a Needs Review filter for borderline candidates
Recruiter side: the Playground lets admins role-play mock applicants against the same scoring engine without touching the real pipeline
Recruiter side: before an interview, the interviewer sees Ada's voice screen summary and transcript in the candidate's history, with AI scores hidden until they submit their own scorecard

cubby.caption: The director's queue at Little Oaks: one understaffed room tomorrow, five past-due families, four stale waitlist entries, each with the facts behind it
Reviewing a tuition nudge before it goes to the family: the director edits the message, and nothing is sent until they approve it
iPhone, Today: whether Meryl is checked in, then two weeks of drop-offs and pickups in the center's time zone
iPhone, Messages: the tuition note the director approved arrives unread, written in the same transaction as the approval
iPhone, Billing: past-due tuition first with the total due, then paid invoices
Android, Today: the same day view in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
Android, Messages: the same approved note, unread, with the badge on the tab
Android, Billing: past due first, then paid
